description.value: Sweet Thea Bakery is an artisan bakery-café in Vancouver's Riley Park neighbourhood run by pastry chef Thea Mercer and her partner Laurie, where every loaf of sourdough takes three days to make using certified organic BC wheat. The open-kitchen space serves hearty scratch-made breakfasts, daily soups, and creative sandwiches alongside buttery croissants, focaccia, and 49th Parallel coffee, with a take-a-book-leave-a-book nook and a standing commitment to donating daily surplus to local charities. The business has grown from farmers' market pop-ups to three locations including a BC Ferries terminal outpost, making it a well-established community fixture.
